channel.title: Debt Payoff & Budgeting
channel.description: Free debt, budget, and savings calculators, plus Excel templates.

item.title: Credit Card Payoff Calculator: How Long Will It Take?
item.description: Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 card at 22% APR takes over 19 years and costs about $8,100 in interest. A fixed $250 a month clears it in 26 months. See your own payoff date and interest, free, no sign-up.

item.title: Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator (Free)
item.description: Snowball pays the smallest balance first; avalanche pays the highest interest rate first. Enter your own debts to see your debt-free date, total interest, and payoff order under both methods. Free, no sign-up, nothing leaves your browser.

item.title: Loan Calculator With Extra Payments (Free)
item.description: On a $25,000 car loan at 7% for 60 months, paying $100 extra a month pays it off 11 months early and saves $938.99 in interest. Try your own loan, extra payments, or a lump sum, with a full amortization schedule.

item.title: Debt Payoff Calculator: See Your Debt-Free Date
item.description: Keep paying the same total each month and roll each paid-off debt's payment into the next one. In this example, $200 extra a month gets you debt-free 20 months sooner and saves $3,554 in interest. Free calculator, snowball or avalanche.
